import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String line = br.readLine();
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line);
        String input = br.readLine();
        String pattern = "\\([\\w_]*\\)";
        String[] parts = input.split(pattern);
        int maxWordLength = 0;
        for (String s : parts) {
            maxWordLength = Math.max(maxWordLength, getLongestWord(s));
        }
        Pattern p = Pattern.compile(pattern);
        Matcher m = p.matcher(input);
        long countInside = 0;
        while (m.find()) {
            String inside = trimParentheses(m.group());
            countInside += Arrays.stream(inside.split("_"))
                                 .filter(str -> !str.isEmpty())
                                 .count();
        }
        pw.println(maxWordLength + " " + countInside);
        pw.flush();
    }

    private static int getLongestWord(String s) {
        return Arrays.stream(s.split("_"))
                     .mapToInt(String::length)
                     .max()
                     .orElse(0);
    }

    private static String trimParentheses(String s) {
        return s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
    }
}
